maxRps.rationale: Prose gives current traffic (~10k rps) through the load balancer but no explicit admission ceiling, so sized with headroom above current load as is typical for an LB/API gateway cap.

instances.rationale: Prose states the API layer currently runs 20 instances behind the load balancer.

concurrencyPerInstance.rationale: No concurrency figure given; used a typical per-instance concurrency for a lightweight stateless HTTP service.

serviceTimeMs.rationale: No timing given; a redirect handler (lookup + 30x response) is CPU/IO-light, so used a typical fast service time excluding downstream cache/DB waits.

hitRate.rationale: Prose says most traffic is for recently-shortened links and the cache 'should absorb a good chunk' of it, implying a high but not near-total hit rate.

hitLatencyMs.rationale: No latency stated; typical in-memory Redis GET latency for a cache-aside lookup.

ttlSeconds.rationale: Prose states a five-minute TTL on the Redis cache.

keyspaceHotSet.rationale: No key cardinality given; used a typical hot-key working-set size for a cache fronting recently-created short links at this traffic volume.

connectionPoolSize.rationale: Prose states Postgres has a connection pool capped at 100 connections.

queryTimeMs.rationale: No query latency given; typical indexed key lookup/insert time for a Postgres table under a connection pool.

writeRatio.rationale: Prose says creating short links happens rarely compared to the vast-majority redirect traffic, implying a small write share.

readReplicas.rationale: Prose explicitly states no read replicas are run.

replicaApplyRate.rationale: With zero read replicas stated, there is no replica apply stream to size.
